# fw learn

> Reference of the fw learn command: Harvest git history, the code graph and docs into a local corpus; search all three; `systemd` prints a unit for a VPS…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/learn/

Harvest git history, the code graph and docs into a local corpus; search all three; `systemd` prints a unit for a VPS

## Usage

```bash
fw learn <status|harvest|distill|search|loop|systemd> [--xfs-root <dir>]
```

## Aliases

`fw autolearn` runs `fw learn`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw learn status
fw learn harvest
fw learn distill
fw learn search
fw learn loop
fw learn systemd
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--xfs-root` | `<dir>` |
